title: Collective improvisation and who is playing jazz
summary: Perhanis presses on whether MJQ, Brubeck and Mulligan groups play jazz. Rose says rehearsed parts are not collective improvisation, and that the differences are stylistic.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
